title: sdmhelpers
text: sdmhelpers provides helper functions support species distribution modelling (SDM) workflows implemented maxnet. package extends target-group approach phenological weighting, temporal overlap estimation, raster-based kernel density estimation (KDE). Furthermore, package includes functionality independent spatial-fold selection model evaluation using validation data true skill statistic (TSS). sdmhelpers developed part project “HiQBioDiv: High-resolution quantification biodiversity conservation management” funded Latvian Council Science (Ref. . VPP-VARAM-DABA-2024/1-0002).
